| Class | Meaning | Stores that provide it | Harness setting |
|---|---|---|---|
| S `synced` | Reply after the write is synced to the device | all nine systems (Cassandra, TiKV, FoundationDB: setting not verified by us) | TideHunter `durability_tier: synchronous`; native `native_durability: value_wal_barrier`; external `ack_contract: synced` (default) |
| P `page_cache` | Reply after the write is in the OS page cache of the storage host (paper section 3.1; the Sui contract) | TideHunter, native, Kvrocks | TideHunter `durability_tier: native`; native `page_cache`; Kvrocks `ack_contract: page_cache` |
| W weaker than P | Reply can precede the kernel write | Valkey only | `ack_contract: os_buffered` (`appendfsync no`), `ack_contract: periodic_sync` (`everysec`) |

Rules for every table and figure: one class per table; class S is the cross-store headline (only common ground); class P is the Sui-contract table (TideHunter, native, Kvrocks); class W rows appear only beside class P, marked "weaker contract, not a ranking". Read rows state "from memory" or "from device"; Valkey has memory only.

## Objectives

| ID | Objective | Answered by |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | Fill the missing TideHunter class S cells of the new design (16 callers; sustained) | Run A |
| O2 | First hardware Sui replay over NVMe-oF, both contracts | Run A |
| O3 | Confirm the cause of the 64 KiB put gap | Task T1 (existing data) + Run A diagnosis cases |
| O4 | Same-fleet, same-topology cross-store comparison in classes S, P, W | Run B |
| O5 | Five-owner numbers of the new design to replace the report rows | Run B |

## Benchmark map

Shapes used everywhere ("core shapes"): put and read; 1 KiB and 64 KiB; 1 and 16 callers; 4,096 measured calls; plus one sustained case of 200,000 puts at 1 KiB with 16 callers.

### Run A: 2 VMs (1 coordinator + 1 owner), focused package, TideHunter and native only

Reviewed spec: new `sui_nvmeof_with_contracts` = focused KV selection `nvmeof_contracts` (below) followed by the four Sui cells of `sui_nvmeof_compact`. Limits: VM creation + 120 minutes, 12 USD compute.

Selection `nvmeof_contracts`, 34 cases, groups G21W 16, G21R 8, G21N 10. All remote cases: `history_persistence: wal_replay`; live cases: `live_write_mode: leased`, `live_lease_ahead: True`, `live_polled_writes: False`, `live_poll_queues: 0`.

| # | Group | Cases | Backend, class | Shape | Objective |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | G21W | 4 | leased NVMe-oF, S | put 1 KiB and 64 KiB, 1 and 16 callers | O1 |
| 2 | G21W | 4 | leased NVMe-oF, P | same four shapes | O1 (same-fleet P against S) |
| 3 | G21W | 2 | leased NVMe-oF, S and P | sustained 200,000 puts, 1 KiB, 16 callers | O1 |
| 4 | G21W | 2 | leased NVMe-oF, S and P | write-timeline copy of put 64 KiB, 16 callers | O3 |
| 5 | G21W | 4 | owner RPC verbs, S | put 1 KiB and 64 KiB, 1 and 16 callers | O1 (control: old route, new recovery) |
| 6 | G21R | 4 | leased NVMe-oF | read from memory: 1 KiB and 64 KiB, 1 and 16 callers | O1 |
| 7 | G21R | 4 | leased NVMe-oF | read from device: same four shapes; the 64 KiB 1-caller case keeps `require_media_qualified` | O1 |
| 8 | G21N | 4 | native, S (`value_wal_barrier`) | put four shapes | reference |
| 9 | G21N | 4 | native, P (`page_cache`) | put four shapes | reference |
| 10 | G21N | 2 | native | read from memory 1 KiB, 1 and 16 callers | reference |

Canaries (first three, in this order): native P put 1 KiB 1 caller; leased S put 1 KiB 1 caller; leased device read 64 KiB 1 caller.

Sui cells (unchanged): r01 owner RPC verbs, `original_default`, native tier (class P); r02 live NVMe-oF, `original_default`, native tier (P); r03 owner RPC verbs, `harness`, synchronous tier (S); r04 live NVMe-oF, `harness`, synchronous (S). Per cell: native replay, remote replay, digest equality, state audit.

### Run B: 6 VMs (1 client/coordinator + 5 storage hosts), full package

Stores and arms, all on one fleet, five storage nodes each (native: one process on the coordinator SSD, as in the report):

| Store | Arms (class) |
|---|---|
| TideHunter leased NVMe-oF, five owners | `synchronous` (S), `native` (P) |
| TideHunter owner RPC verbs, five owners | `synchronous` (S), `native` (P) |
| native | `value_wal_barrier` (S), `page_cache` (P) |
| Valkey RDMA | `synced` (S), `os_buffered` (W), `periodic_sync` (W) |
| Valkey TCP | `synced` (S) |
| Kvrocks | `synced` (S), `page_cache` (P) |

Per arm: the core shapes (reads only once per store; a read does not depend on the write contract, run it under the S arm) and the sustained case. Two repetitions of each 4,096-call case. Not rerun: Garnet, Cassandra, TiKV, FoundationDB (no clean class P mode; they stay historical in the class S table with the caveat "other fleet; device sync not verified" where it applies).

Gate for launching Run B (owner decision, recorded here): Run A complete, O3 answered, and the owner states whether a 64 KiB fix must land first.
